title: Patriot 26 Fire and Rescue, Civil Engineers, Overview Reel
description:
Senior Master Sergeant Thomas Dunnan, 115th Fighter Wing, Wisconsin Air National Guard speaks about fire and rescue training and civil engineers on Volk Field Air National Guard Base, Wisconsin, Aug. 26, 2026. Patriot 26, an Air National Guard-hosted exercise taking place at Volk Field Combat Readiness Training Center, brings together approximately 1,000 Airmen and Soldiers from National Guard units across 35 states, along with federal, state and local agencies, to enhance domestic response readiness and interagency coordination during large-scale emergencies. (U.S. Army National Guard video by Sgt. Chasity Williams)
